item.title: Senate Democrats say banks turned blind eye to suspicious moves by Jeffrey Epstein
item.description: A report from Senate Democrats accuses big banks of failing to report suspicious money transfers made by Jeffrey Epstein until after his arrest in 2019.

item.title: 5 states hold primaries today. And, Spokane police arrest man connected to wildfire
item.description: Five state primaries are being held today, and Michigan is a key focus for Democrats who want to see how progressives fare in races. And, a man has been arrested in connection with a Spokane fire.
